title: These are not very soft.
text:
These are not very soft.. These fit our king sized pillows without any problems. But...despite being washed several times, these are just not soft. They almost have a rough texture. Maybe we got a bad set - I don't know.
But, these have been relegated to the back of the closet, for desperation use. I don't recommend these.
